description: Dastardly Print buyer-support and Concierge work: customer message triage, Etsy-style response drafting, review recovery, and handoff discipline under brand and policy constraints. The tasks are single-turn benchmark prompts that represent the DP support surface without editing or invoking live DP lanes.

tasks.title: Resolve a buyer's missing digital-download access
tasks.prompt:
You are the Dastardly Print buyer-support concierge. A buyer writes: "I bought the printable wall art pack yesterday, but the download link says expired. I need it for a gift tonight. Can you just email me the files?" Known facts: the order exists, the buyer's email matches the order, the storefront policy allows re-sending the official download link, and support must not send files directly from a personal address.

Return ONLY JSON: {"tone": "friendly"|"defensive", "action": string, "reply": string, "handoff": string|null}. The reply must be <=90 words, apologize briefly, say you will refresh/re-send the official download link, and must NOT promise a refund or ask the buyer to repurchase.

criteria.name: support_quality
criteria.guidance: Helpful, fast, and policy-safe: acknowledges urgency, uses the official download-link path, avoids personal file email, refund promises, or making the buyer repurchase.

tasks.title: Recover a low review without arguing publicly
tasks.prompt:
A buyer left a 2-star public review: "Colors printed way darker than the listing photo. Disappointed." Facts: this is a digital printable file; print color can vary by printer/paper/settings; the listing includes a short print-settings note; the buyer has not contacted support yet. Write a public reply and private next action. Do not blame the buyer, the printer, Etsy, or the customer. Do not guarantee a 5-star review change.

Return ONLY JSON: {"publicReply": string, "privateAction": string, "avoid": string}. publicReply <=70 words.

criteria.name: review_recovery
criteria.guidance: Public reply is calm, non-defensive, buyer-facing, and invites support. Private action should troubleshoot print settings or replacement help without guaranteeing review manipulation.

tasks.title: Scope a custom request and route design work
tasks.prompt:
A repeat buyer asks: "Can you turn the poster into a Canva template and add my restaurant's logo? I need it by tomorrow." Facts: Concierge handles buyer communication, not custom design production; logo use requires buyer-owned rights confirmation; Canva-template conversion is a new custom deliverable that needs BrandDesigner or FoundingEngineer review before quoting. Decide the support response.

Return ONLY JSON: {"decision": "handle"|"handoff_designer"|"decline", "needsRightsConfirmation": true|false, "buyerReply": string, "handoffNote": string}. buyerReply <=80 words.

deterministic.value: I can do that by tomorrow

criteria.name: handoff_discipline
criteria.guidance: Keeps Concierge in support lane, confirms logo rights, avoids promising deadline/quote before review, and creates a precise handoff to the design/technical owner.
